description: This file contains the ReferenceHelper class, which provides methods for parsing, updating, and managing cell and range references within spreadsheets. It includes functions for sorting, adjusting references during insertions/deletions, and updating formulas and defined names. It's a core component for reference management in the PhpSpreadsheet library.

classes.name: ReferenceHelper
classes.description: A utility class managing cell and range references within spreadsheets, including reference sorting, updates during insertions/deletions, formula modification, and handling of named ranges and formulas.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of ReferenceHelper.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Protected constructor to enforce singleton pattern.

methods.name: columnSort
methods.description: Static method to compare and sort column addresses alphabetically.

methods.name: columnReverseSort
methods.description: Static method to compare and sort column addresses in reverse order.

methods.name: cellSort
methods.description: Static method to compare cell addresses first by row then by column for sorting.

methods.name: cellReverseSort
methods.description: Static method to reverse sort cell addresses.

methods.name: adjustPageBreaks
